scope.runtime_mode: HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA=1, which already requires resident state and HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA=1

algorithm.selection: Sixteen most-significant-first four-bit histogram passes locate the unique kth 64-bit composite key.
algorithm.ranking: Exactly k qualifying keys are collected and bitonic-sorted in one threadgroup.
algorithm.stable_key: Monotone IEEE-f32 score in the high 32 bits plus inverted sequence position in the low 32 bits; unsigned descending order is score descending with lower position first.

edge_semantics.signed_zero: -0 and +0 are canonicalized equal, so lower position wins
edge_semantics.nan: mapped to -infinity; admitted DSA scores are required finite and complete-token parity remains fail-closed

algorithm.serial_oracle: gravity_glm_stable_topk_f32 remains compiled only as an exact test and benchmark oracle; the device DSA runtime calls the radix kernel.

persistent_buffers_reused: existing fixed O(index_topk) compact ranked-index buffer
memory.removed_runtime_state: one u8 selected marker per sequence-capacity position

bounded_measurement.protocol: One warmup and five measured repetitions per implementation; each repetition used one command buffer and included commit-and-wait wall time; both outputs were exact against the host authority.
bounded_measurement.qualification: Bounded kernel-only Metal timing under active MOP load. The radix series contains one 9151 us scheduling outlier; the robust median is reported. This is not sealed-model throughput evidence.

complete_token_numeric_parity_v2_1.fixture: deterministic one-layer, 16-vocabulary complete-token direct-u8 PQ fixture

default_resident_parity.command: env -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA cargo test -p hawking-core --test gravity_glm_resident_parity -- --nocapture

default_gpu_forward.command: env -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA -u HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA cargo test -p hawking-core --test gravity_glm_gpu_forward -- --nocapture

promotion_gate.reason: Active MOP forbids the sealed-model A/B and sustained-context validation required for runtime promotion.
promotion_gate.next_architectural_floor: The full indexer still commits wq_b and wk before host affine LayerNorm and q/k RoPE construction; those operations must move into the same device command graph.
